title: Document the role-slot description field in config-sample.json
action: Add a description_field entry to _doc.models.slot_shapes explaining the optional description string on object-shaped slots (planner documentation only, shown in the preamble Roles line clipped to 60 chars, ignored by resolution/guard/dispatch prepare; string slots must use the {model, description} spelling), and put a live description on the sample's models.claude.generation object.
verify: cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee onboard -- --nocapture: the embedded config-sample.json parse/shape tests stay green over the edited file
notes: Follow-up to feature role-slot-description (PBI p-a1399c00). The repo file is the single source: onboard/templates.rs embeds it via include_str, so editing .bee/config-sample.json updates the template new repos are seeded from.

trace.outcome: config-sample.json documents the optional role-slot description field (_doc slot_shapes entry + live generation example)
